description: This file defines the RelationshipType class in Java, representing types of relationships between people in the OpenMRS system, including properties like identifier, relationship descriptions, weight, and preferences.

classes.name: RelationshipType
classes.description: A class representing a type of relationship between two people, including relationship labels, weight, and preference status, suitable for use in a healthcare records system.

methods.name: getRelationshipTypeId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the relationship type.

methods.name: setRelationshipTypeId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the relationship type.

methods.name: getWeight
methods.description: Returns the weight associated with the relationship type.

methods.name: setWeight
methods.description: Sets the weight associated with the relationship type.

methods.name: getaIsToB
methods.description: Returns the descriptive label for the relationship from entity A to entity B.

methods.name: setaIsToB
methods.description: Sets the descriptive label for the relationship from entity A to entity B.

methods.name: getbIsToA
methods.description: Returns the descriptive label for the relationship from entity B to entity A.

methods.name: setbIsToA
methods.description: Sets the descriptive label for the relationship from entity B to entity A.

methods.name: isPreferred
methods.description: Deprecated method; returns whether this relationship type is preferred.

methods.name: getPreferred
methods.description: Returns whether this relationship type is preferred, used as default when adding/editing relationships.

methods.name: setPreferred
methods.description: Sets whether this relationship type is preferred.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the relationship type in the format 'aIsToB/bIsToA'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the OpenmrsObject interface method to get the identifier, delegating to getRelationshipTypeId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Implements the OpenmrsObject interface method to set the identifier, delegating to setRelationshipTypeId.
